findings.description: comp_tickets uses only require_login, so any logged-in attendee can issue free tickets (up to 50 per request) to any holder. Other privileged endpoints (cancel_event, attendee_list) use require_role. This allows free tickets and exhausting event capacity.
findings.suggestion: Replace require_login with require_role(request.user, Role.STAFF, Role.ADMIN) and use the returned user for issued_by.
findings.title: Comp ticket endpoint lacks role authorization
